title: 8 killed and more than 60 wounded in Ukrainian drone attack on Russian regions
summary: Kyiv's forces are continuing their aerial campaign against energy infrastructure and military targets inside Russia, aiming to undermine Moscow's war effort.
contentText:
Kyiv's forces are continuing their aerial campaign against energy infrastructure and military targets inside Russia, aiming to undermine Moscow's war effort.

(Image credit: Moscow Region Governor Andrei Vo)
